subject: [PATCH v2 2/4] kernfs: take kernfs_rename_lock for same-parent renames too

2026-09-05.patch_summary: This patch modifies the kernfs_rename_ns function to take the kernfs_rename_lock lock even when renaming a node within its existing parent directory, not just when moving it to a new parent. This is done to prevent a bug where concurrent renames can create a path that never existed, and also to ensure that readers get a stable name. The patch takes into account the rare occurrence of renames and the fact that the lock is per filesystem, making it a reasonable trade-off for stability.
